strings.accountconfignote: Payment gateways for this account will be configured separately
strings.accountdeleteconfirm: If this account has previous payments, it will be archived, otherwise its configuration data will be permanently deleted. Are you sure you want to continue?
strings.accountidnumber_help: The ID number is only used when matching the account against external systems and is not displayed anywhere on the site. If the account has an official code name it may be entered, otherwise the field can be left blank.
strings.accountname_help: How this account will be identified for teachers or managers who set up payments (for example in the course enrolment plugin).
strings.feeincludesurcharge: {$a->fee} (includes {$a->surcharge}% surcharge for using this payment type)
strings.gatewaycannotbeenabled: The payment gateway cannot be enabled because the configuration is incomplete.
strings.gotomanageplugins: Enable and disable payment gateways and set surcharges via {$a}.
strings.gotopaymentaccounts: Create payment accounts using any of these gateways in {$a}.
strings.nocurrencysupported: No payment in any currency is supported. Please make sure that at least one payment gateway is enabled.
strings.nogateway: There is no payment gateway that can be used.
strings.nogatewayselected: You first need to select a payment gateway.
strings.paymentaccountsexplained: Create one or multiple payment accounts for this site. Each account includes configuration for available payment gateways. The person who configures payments on the site (for example, payment for the course enrolment) will be able to choose from the available accounts.
strings.privacy:metadata:database:payments:gatew: The payment gateway that is used for the payment.
strings.privacy:metadata:database:payments:timec: The time when the payment was made.
strings.privacy:metadata:database:payments:timem: The time when the payment record was last updated.
strings.privacy:metadata:database:payments:useri: The user who made the payment.
strings.surcharge_desc: The surcharge is an additional percentage charged to users who choose to pay using this payment gateway.
